name: Assimilator
headline: Assimilator
description: A blend of digestive enzymes with vitamins A and D. It supports better absorption of nutrients from food and helps reduce discomfort in the stomach and intestines.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule once a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Enzyme blend (protease, amylase, lipase, maltase, lactase, papain, bromelain, cellulase), vitamins A and D, excipients.
